entries.e68c87929753b951: The company group's sole business, which manufactures cemented carbide and tools and sells products and the like. The company manufactures everything from cemented carbide materials to finished products, and sales are handled by the company, its U.S. company DIJET INC., and its German company DIJET GmbH, through agents, distributors and dealers as well as direct sales to customers. Wear-resistant tools are also manufactured and sold by Daijiehanjin (Cangzhou) Precision Mold Co., Ltd., an equity-method affiliate in China. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is ¥9,292 million. Principal facilities are the head office and plant in Hirano-ku, Osaka, the plant group in Iga, Mie Prefecture, and the Tondabayashi plant.
